# Merriam-Webster

> > America's most trusted dictionary and language reference, providing comprehensive word definitions, synonyms, antonyms, and language learning tools.

Merriam-Webster offers over 300,000 word definitions through its online dictionary and thesaurus, along with mobile apps for iOS and Android. Part of Encyclopaedia Britannica's family of language resources, it serves as the authoritative reference for American English, including specialized tools for word games like SCRABBLE.

## Key Topics

- English language reference
- Dictionary definitions
- Thesaurus and synonyms
- Word games and SCRABBLE
- Mobile dictionary apps
- Vocabulary building
- Language learning
- Writing tools
- Antonyms and word relationships
- Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary
- App Store and Google Play
- Learner's Dictionary
- Word finder tools

## Core Dictionary & Thesaurus

- [Merriam-Webster: America's Most Trusted Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/): Homepage: America's most trusted dictionary with 300K+ word definitions
- [Thesaurus by Merriam-Webster: Find Synonyms, Similar Words, and Antonyms](https://www.merriam-webster.com/thesaurus): Merriam-Webster Thesaurus for finding synonyms, antonyms, and similar words

## Mobile Apps & Tools

- [Dictionary and Word Game Apps | Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/apps): Mobile dictionary and word game apps for iOS and Android platforms

## About & Information

- [About Us | Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/about-us): About Merriam-Webster and Encyclopaedia Britannica's language resources
